record.summary: Exact degree-four free-Wick law for symmetric r by r cores forces rank(Q) at most r; for m>r the whitened ordered-product defect has operator norm at least one and Frobenius norm at least sqrt(m^2-r^2).
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for a generic high-rank free-semicircular replacement; retain only low-rank or Bellman-dark-defect cases.
